protocol.title: 30分钟结构回调：确认时序与关键位职责对照
protocol.purpose: Two finite single-factor contrasts on already-exposed development data. Immutable v9 controls are reproduced as v10 explicit legacy semantics. Independent opportunity observations retain market/EMA lifecycle and ignore only account holding/cooldown. No parameter search, target ranking or same-round combined variant.
protocol.selection: Predeclared sp-context only; sp-confirm-close is a separate mechanism diagnostic, never a fallback winner.

transferEvaluation.method: Fixed primary only; daily dollar portfolio returns; shared circular date blocks across both rules/costs. No independent-trade resampling or target ranking.
transferEvaluation.acceptance: Development requires source-domain activity qualification, positive base-cost account return and daily drawdown at most10%; only then unlock validation. Validation and holdout require all sample gates, positive net return and daily drawdown at most10% under base/stress, with both 7/28day absolute mean-return 95% lower bounds above zero. No fallback candidate or universe replacement.

limitations: Current static execution filters; not point-in-time historical rules.
Three surviving contracts per group are purposive, correlated market samples; no cross-asset-class independence.
Minute OHLC uses fixed bps fills; no order book, queue, partial fills or live outage simulation.
The fixed 3bar impulse and pivot-based pattern definitions are research hypotheses, not a full reconstruction of discretionary Brooks price action.
No volume-profile ownership/cost-basis inference from OHLCV. H2/H3 discretionary setup counting is not interchangeable with confirmed pivot legs.
This is the second adaptive development round on these observations. Prior failed strategies and six v1 rules remain evidence; new registration does not reset total multiple-testing exposure.
Independent opportunity records use the shared detector and original EMA cancellation rules, but do not inherit portfolio holdings, cooldown or risk rejections. They are not executed account returns.

Impulse context qualifies a previously known pivot crossed during the impulse or a pre-validated EMA on the correct side at the origin. Neither qualification requires another pullback retest; subsequent invalidation and signal-side requirements remain.
Timing variant only confirms an older pivot using the completed signal candle; it does not confirm the signal candle as a pivot, backfill old signals or change fills.

instrumentRules.interpretation: Existing source constraints for historical develop/validation, official cached current snapshot for reserved future instruments. No future price observations; a material exchange rule change requires an explicitly recorded protocol revision, never a silent symbol replacement.

adaptation.reason: Two semantic hypotheses follow the failed exposed-data v1 study. Same-close confirmation and key context are tested separately; this is adaptive development, not fresh out-of-sample discovery.
adaptation.retained: 30-minute bars, full pre-pullback impulse extreme breakout, 2ATR initial / 3ATR chandelier, no break-even, risk, costs, symbol/time groups and qualification thresholds.
adaptation.selection: sp-context is predeclared primary; no fallback to the timing contrast or any other candidate.

confirmation.change: A completed breakout candle may confirm a centre pivot two candles earlier; confirmedAt <= signalTime; signal candle itself is never the pivot; trade next minute.

keyRole.change: Key eligibility is established during the impulse rather than requiring a repeated pullback touch. Shape gate disabled in both arms to avoid previous near-empty intersection.
keyRole.pivot: Choose the same latest high/low known at origin, origin on opposite side; qualify a tick-confirmed impulse cross and freeze eligibility when pullback begins.
keyRole.ema: Freeze eligibility at origin: prior two-touch validation exists and signed origin close minus then-observed EMA >= 0.
keyRole.continuedProtection: Prior identity is immutable; subsequent inverse-side closes beyond existing 0.25A0 tolerance still invalidate; first-break close must be on current key trend side.
